# Fortex Appliance Repair

> Licensed (CA #50759) and insured appliance repair across Orange County, CA. Technicians come to the customer; there is no walk-in shop. Service visit is waived with any repair. 1-year warranty on OEM parts, 90 days on labor. OEM parts by default; a lower-cost aftermarket part is offered when it would do the job without losing quality, and the customer decides.

- Phone: (949) 478-0089
- Email: fortexappliancerepair@gmail.com
- Hours: Mon–Sat 9am–6pm, Sunday closed
- Based in: Huntington Beach, CA (mobile service, no walk-in shop)
- Book online: https://www.fortexappliancerepair.com/book/

## Pricing and warranty

- The diagnostic visit is $80. If you go ahead with the repair, the diagnostic fee is waived. After checking the appliance, we explain the findings and give you the repair price before work begins.
- The $80 service call applies to every service, wine cellar cooling included; outside Orange County a travel fee is quoted when you call.
- Dryer vent: we inspect exhaust restrictions and clean dryer vents that exit through an exterior side wall; we do not clean vents that exit through the roof.
- Warranty: 1-year warranty on OEM parts, 90-day labor.
